note.question: How do methods and application to COVID-19 detection interact?
note.overview: Simple and affordable testing tools are often not accurate enough to be operationally relevant. For coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) detection, rapid point-of-care tests are cheap and provide results in minutes, but they largely fail policy makers’ accuracy requirements. The paper proposes an analytical methodology, based on robust optimization, that identifies optimal combinations of results from cheap tests for increased predictive accuracy.
